requirement: CTO change-management requirement: a retrieved research run must expose consistent source, dependency, dataset and result provenance plus explicit metric validity, and operational health must not be treated as release authorization.
failure_case: A release consumer interprets health=ok and a numeric Sharpe or tail-risk value as final-release approval despite unresolved gates and insufficient sample evidence.
finding: Partial: observed list/detail provenance is consistent and insufficient-sample/unavailable metrics are explicit. Health reports process health only; none of the three response bodies provides a release gate decision or approval audit trail. Local milestone records keep M16/M21/M22 in_progress. This is a release-consumer integration gap, not evidence that the health endpoint violates its documented contract.
limitations: Only one existing trusted synthetic research run was inspected; no campaign or strategy was executed.
Manifest hashes were compared as returned metadata, not recomputed from downloaded source/report/dataset artifacts; hashes do not prove publisher authenticity.
No operational log, approval history, containment, backup recovery, workload benchmark, GUI or current installed-source equivalence was verified.
Sample 2026-07-01 through 2026-09-01 has 43 rows; it does not establish six months testing, OOS validation or 30 days actual paper simulation.
Annualization=252 and annual risk-free rate=0 are recorded; sampling frequency and drawdown algorithm were not independently established in this review. No economic or strategy eligibility verdict.
M21 report dated through its 2026-10-02 evidence is historical context, not a fresh rerun; local milestone state was read on this run.
Only local authorized synthetic research evidence was used; no external market data source or publication was accessed.
recommendation: Coordinator should require an explicit versioned release decision linked to independent gate evidence; never derive release readiness from /health or metric values. Keep final release withheld pending gate closure.
confidence: high for observed response scope; no claim about uninspected interfaces
